connector.name: CloakBrowser MCP
connector.registryDescription: Playwright MCP-compatible browser automation bridge for CloakBrowser Chromium.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cloakbrowser-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the swimmwatch account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_BROWSER_ENGINE
env.description: Bridge browser engine: cloak or playwright.

env.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_HEADLESS
env.description: Run the browser in headless mode.

env.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
env.description: Directory where upstream Playwright MCP writes artifacts.

env.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_OUTPUT_MODE
env.description: Return snapshots, console logs, and network logs through stdout or files.

env.name: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_USER_DATA_DIR
env.description: Persistent Chromium profile directory. The bridge resolves it to an absolute path and writes it to generated Playwright MCP config.

env.name: CLOAK_PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_CONTEXT_OPTIONS
env.description: JSON object with validated Playwright context options such as viewport, locale, timezoneId, permissions, geolocation, and headers.

env.name: CLOAK_PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_EXTENSION_PATHS
env.description: JSON array or comma-separated list of Chrome extension directories. Requires PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_USER_DATA_DIR.

env.name: CLOAK_PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_CONSOLE_FALLBACK
env.description: Patch upstream console message collection for CloakBrowser compatibility.

env.name: CLOAK_PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_GEOIP_PROXY_MATCH
env.description: Resolve proxy GeoIP and match CloakBrowser timezone/locale fingerprint flags when PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_PROXY_SERVER is set.

env.description: Comma-separated or JSON array of extra Chromium launch arguments.
